ValidationRule.description: Reasons Not Returning Other must have a value if "Other" is a selected option in the Reasons Not Returning field.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK( Reasons_Not_Returning_Other__c ), ISPICKVAL( Type , "Continued Enrollment"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Student_Intention__c ,"Not returning ever"), ISPICKVAL( Student_Intention__c ,"Not returning temporarily") ), INCLUDES( Reasons_Not_Returning__c ,"Other"), RecordTypeId = '012d00000021xGK' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Reasons Not Returning Other is required when the Student's Intention is "Not returning" and a Reason Not Returning is "Other"
